title: Xake project description
description: What a project is: data only, rarely changes; written by an explicit import or by hand, committed. `project` is relative to this file; every other path is relative to the project file's folder. No placeholders: a variant msbuild evaluates differently (a brand) is a separate description; configurations, output layout and versions are the script's knowledge. Read and written by `Xake.Dotnet.Description` in the Xake package (docs/description.md), composed into a compilation by csc/fsc { project }; properties are listed in the order the writer emits them.

version.description: As the project file declares it (exact or NuGet range). Resolved at lock generation, never by fsc/csc.

private.description: Compile-time only (PrivateAssets=all): not a nuspec dependency.

references.description: Framework assemblies by name (grefs), e.g. System.Windows.Forms; an entry with a folder (lib/Foo.dll) is an assembly by path, relative to the project file's folder

frameworkReferences.description: Shared frameworks (msbuild's FrameworkReference items), referenced from the SDK's targeting packs

resources.description: Embedded resources only this framework has (an EmbeddedResource under a condition on the framework)

file.description: A plain file, embedded as is, or a .resx, compiled to a .resources by `project`

name.description: Manifest name (msbuild's LogicalName, or the ManifestResourceName msbuild gave it when the import ran its targets); default msbuild's: rootNamespace (else name), the folder path as an identifier, the file name (a .resx: without extension, plus .resources)

noWarn.description: Warnings suppressed beyond the SDK's defaults (C# 1701, 1702), which `project` adds

key.description: Public key of the friend assembly

args.description: Arguments as source text, emitted verbatim: ["true"], ["\"text\""]

metadata.description: Present when the project is packed. Every field may be overridden by the script.

icon.description: File packed at the package root

readme.description: File packed at the package root

bundle.description: projectRefs (names) whose assemblies go into this package's lib/<tfm>/ instead of becoming a dependency

name.description: Project key: the project file name without extension (Xake.Dotnet, Layout); unique within a build; names the lock folder and the {name} of the layout

project.description: The project file, relative to this description; lets a description live outside the project's repo. Other paths are relative to the project file's folder

sources.description: In compile order (semantic for F#). C#: msbuild's globs kept as Xake masks

projectRefs.description: Names of other described projects. Lock generation picks each one's configuration and framework and records the choice as the reference's output path in the referencer's lock

assemblyAttributes.description: Assembly-level attributes (msbuild's AssemblyAttribute items), generated into the same source as internalsVisibleTo

byFramework.description: Additions for one target framework only, keyed by a TFM listed in frameworks
